subject: Request to substitute a PVC alternate in lieu of the cast-iron roof drain leader

messages.text: We're proposing a PVC alternate in lieu of the cast-iron roof drain leader specified in Section 22 14 00 and want sign-off before we order material. This is becoming a priority given current supplier lead times. This substitution is cost-neutral. This substitution will not affect the domestic water pressure test date. Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
